scope: Complete source-only read of final announced 4369a205 driver; pinned manifests, compiler config, installed Zod method and final probe read. No parser/import/compiler/product execution or source writes. Future copy not created.

blockingFindings.finding: Outer exception handler tests BASE.exists(), not ownership. Rejection of a pre-existing BASE enters that handler and can create HALTED.json in an unowned or completed frozen namespace. This contradicts the no retry/overwrite boundary.
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Record successful exclusive BASE.mkdir ownership for this invocation and permit HALTED writes only after that ownership is established. Preserve v1 bytes and independently bind any revision before execution.

observations.finding: 8751 tracked and 4529 compiled rows are manifest-pinned. Each future copy2 is physically separate from its corresponding source and nlink1; node_modules is borrowed, not independently installed. No .git copy is introduced.

Exact one-anchor mutation appends .passthrough() to the existing strict first state branch. Installed Zod method replaces catchall with unknown while preserving the discriminator shape. It affects requested, authorized, started and outcome_unknown only.

Real tsc child runs before mutant checks. Manifest differences allow only receipt.ts, receipt.js and existing compiled .d.ts paths. Actual changed inputs are retained and rehashed after checks. Schema generation --write is never invoked.

Every child starts a new session, records PID/observed group/argv and real exit, then probes its group with signal zero for positive ESRCH before returning. Unexpected result stops later phases and restoration. Only actual 0/1 expected exits may proceed. observedPgid=None is explicitly accepted by code; do not report it as an observed positive PGID.

Restoration follows both completed mutant children and preservation checks. All listed bytes/modes and parent rows are rechecked; native SHA/inode/nlink are compared at completion. This does not cover all dependency files or new unlisted files, and does not establish whole-process-family isolation.

Child wait is deliberately unbounded; the five-second deadline bounds post-exit group absence polling only. No timeout, signal, automatic retry or restoration-on-exception exists. Metadata must not describe this as an outer runtime deadline.

Marker checks identify expected mutant assertions/staleness, but full raw stderr/source attribution and unexpected-error audit remain necessary after actual execution; no causal result follows from static review.
